displayName: OCI-AI-PI-005: AI — Prompt Injection via Few-Shot Manipulation
description:
Detects few-shot learning manipulation attacks that inject malicious examples into LLM context

conditions.value: ai — prompt injection via few-shot manipulation

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pi_005", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%injection%') AND "value" > 0
